note: Mostly the Marathi film lavani, from the tamasha films of 1947–1978 (Sulochana Chavan, Usha Mangeshkar, Asha Bhosle, Lata Mangeshkar) to Ajay–Atul's revival from 2008; Shobha Gurtu and Roshan Satarkar stand for the seated and the stage singers. No recording of a working tamasha troupe was found.

size.basis: No source counts recordings. One Marathi song-lyrics archive (Aathavanitli Gani) tags about 136 film and record songs as lavani; that is the well-known, mostly 1947–1990 film and gramophone layer only. Single singers have whole lavani albums of 8–13 tracks (Sulochana Chavan's Rangat Rangali Lavani, Mala Baghun Martoy Dola Lavnya, Marathi Lavanya; Surekha Punekar's compilation), and Wikipedia names a line of stage singers and poets (Surekha Punekar, Sandhya Mane, Roshan Satarkar, many tamasha troupes since the early 1970s) whose cassette and VCD output is large and uncatalogued, plus a steady stream of new film and online singles. An insider's essential list is about 50 songs, most of them film lavanis.
